This Residential Lease Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of [Agreement Date], by and between
[Landlord Full Legal Name] (hereinafter referred to as the "Landlord"), and [Tenant Full Legal Name]

and exclusively as a private residential home.

2. LEASE TERM AND OCCUPANCY

The term of this lease shall commence at 12:01 AM on [Lease Start Date] and shall conclude at 11:59 PM on [Lease End
Date]. The Tenant must furnish written notice at least sixty (60) days prior to the expiration date indicating their intent to
renew the tenancy or vacate the Premises. The Premises shall be occupied solely by the named Tenant and designated
registered occupants: [Occupant Names / None]. Subletting, Airbnb operations, licensing, or assignments without
express written consent from the Landlord are strictly prohibited.

3. RENTAL CONSIDERATION AND DUE DATES

The agreed rental consideration for the Premises shall be [$2,400.00] per calendar month. Rent is due and payable on or
before the first (1st) day of each month via electronic funds transfer (ACH) or accredited direct deposit to the account
instructed by the Landlord. If full rent is not received by 11:59 PM on the fifth (5th) calendar day of the month, a late
processing charge of [$75.00] or 5% of the unpaid balance, whichever is greater, shall apply as liquidated damages.

4. SECURITY DEPOSIT PROTECTION

Upon signing this Agreement, the Tenant shall deposit with the Landlord the sum of [$2,400.00] as security for the
faithful performance of all obligations hereunder. The deposit shall be maintained in a compliant, segregated banking
account. The Landlord shall return the full security deposit within twenty-one (21) to thirty (30) days of vacating, less any
legitimate deductions for unpaid utilities, delinquent charges, or damage beyond normal, expected wear and tear.

5. UTILITIES, UPKEEP, AND MAINTENANCE OBLIGATIONS

The Tenant shall be responsible for contracting and paying all consumable utilities, including electricity, cooking gas,
internet, and cable services. Water, sewer, and municipal refuse collection shall be provided by [Landlord / Tenant as
agreed]. The Tenant covenants to maintain the interior Premises in a clean, sanitary condition, replace HVAC filters
quarterly, test smoke and CO detectors monthly, and immediately report plumbing leaks or structural defects in writing to
prevent property deterioration.

6. QUIET ENJOYMENT, ALTERATIONS, AND RULES

The Tenant shall respect the peaceful enjoyment of neighbors and adhere to municipal quiet hours (10:00 PM to 7:00 AM).
No architectural modifications, interior painting, wallpapering, or lock replacements shall be executed without prior written
approval of the Landlord. Pets are prohibited on the Premises unless formally authorized under an appended pet rider.

The Landlord or authorized agents shall possess the right to enter the Premises during customary business hours for routine
